items.title: What does Fortis Invicta do?
items.answer: Fortis Invicta Ltd develops practical approaches to food preservation, agricultural waste recovery, affordable energy, sustainable buildings and digital access in The Gambia. Individual projects are at different stages of preparation.

items.title: Is the BSF pilot already operating commercially?
items.answer: The proposed BSF trials and training hub is in pilot preparation. Technical review, infrastructure costs, feedstock requirements and financing need to be agreed before implementation and scale-up.

items.title: How can an organisation work with Fortis?
items.answer: Contact Fortis with your area of interest and a specific contribution, such as suitable feedstocks, fabrication, research, technical expertise, premises, distribution or pilot support. No investment or partnership commitment is implied until agreed.

items.title: Is project funding confirmed?
items.answer: Development to date has relied on the CEO’s personal equity. External funding routes are being explored; this website does not announce a confirmed grant, partner investment or co-funding commitment.

items.title: Where can I find project documents and event photographs?
items.answer: Approved public briefs are listed in Documents. Published updates and event albums appear in News & gallery. Contact Fortis if the material you need has not yet been published.
